prompt.text:
Implement `renderTemplate(template, values)` in JavaScript.

`template` must be a string. `values` must be a non-null, non-array object whose own enumerable keys match `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` and whose values are strings. Placeholders have the exact form `{{key}}` with no internal whitespace.

Replace every placeholder occurrence with its corresponding value. Repeated placeholders must be replaced repeatedly. Throw `RangeError` if the template contains a validly shaped placeholder with no own property in `values`. Text that does not match the placeholder syntax remains unchanged. An empty template returns an empty string. Validate every own enumerable key and value even if unused. Do not mutate either argument.

Use CommonJS and export exactly `{ renderTemplate }` with `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
